main_text.p: eam Libertatem, quâ nec Ipse ampliore frui postulo, nedum aliorum opprime-re[?]. Neque reverà credendum est, Proceres illos, cæterosquë (qui in Partibus meis erant) splendidis plurimos Familiis ita prodigos suæ Libertatis fuisse, ut servitutem sibi & Posteris, fortunis suis & sanguine procuratam voluerint.

Quod ad Civiles Immunitates attinet, nemo (pauculis tantum exceptis, obstinatis ambitiosa sua & avara consilia quaquaversum agere & ferre per ruinas Ecclefiæ, Status, Principis, Procerum Populi) vel majorem Libertatem optaret, quàm quæ à Lege[?] permittitur: cuius Iustos limites Boni Viri Ornamento sibi ducunt & Præsidio, cæteri Compedes appellant, & Gravamina.

Haud interim æquum censendum est, ut quis Legis beneficia & præmia exspectet, illam Normam sibi, & Moderatricem asper-natus; merito enim fraudatur Patrocinio Legis, qui dissolutam anhelat Liber-tatem.
Tempus melius erudiet Subditos Meos, illos optimè veram Libertatem conserva-re,qui sibi minimam licentiam vel contra Leges, vel extra illas indulgent.
Sentient aliquando damno suo, quicquid simulant hi homines) omnino fieri ncn[?] posse, ut ullo molli & tenero affectu

page.notes: Blot or stain over the "o" of "opprimere" in the first paragraph, so the reading is uncertain (marked [?]). The word "Lege" in the second paragraph also has a blot over the "e" (marked [?]). "ncn" in the last paragraph reads as printed; it looks like a misprint for "non", left as printed (marked [?]). Dark stain at the left margin beside the first lines and show-through are not transcribed.
